items.briefing:
Bitdefender has issued a warning specifically for the Asia-Pacific region about scams targeting schools and educational organisations, which is directly relevant to staff at registered training organisations. Cybercriminals are using deceptive tactics to exploit the education sector, so be alert to suspicious emails, invoices, or requests that seem out of the ordinary. Abnormal AI has also highlighted that phishing attacks via email remain a leading threat for organisations.

**Practical tip:** If you receive an unexpected email requesting payment, login details, or urgent action — even if it appears to come from a known contact — verify it by phone before responding or clicking any links.
